description: This file contains the implementation of MainActivity for an Android app. It manages the main UI interactions including login, logout, locking/unlocking sessions with biometric authentication, calling protected APIs, and updating the status log. It also handles lifecycle events to coordinate biometric prompts and session states.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity class that provides UI controls for biometric authentication, user login/session management, and logged status display.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, binds views, sets up observers, and restores biometric prompt state.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Handles app resumption logic, including re-locking sessions and prompting for biometric unlock if returning from background.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the biometric prompt state for activity recreation.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Marks activity as backgrounded for session management.

methods.name: bindViews
methods.description: Links UI components to code variables.

methods.name: wireClicks
methods.description: Sets up click event handlers for UI buttons.

methods.name: observeAuthState
methods.description: Observes authentication state changes and reacts accordingly, including navigation to home screen.

methods.name: observeStatusLog
methods.description: Updates the status log UI with latest entries.

methods.name: setButtonsEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables UI buttons based on the current app state.

methods.name: maybePromptUnlock
methods.description: Initiates biometric authentication prompt if session is locked and biometric authentication is available.

methods.name: routeToHomeIfUnlocked
methods.description: Navigates to the home activity if the session is unlocked.

methods.name: routeToHome
methods.description: Starts transition to HomeActivity, preventing multiple triggers.
